text:
Ana (CS): quick sync — i'm drafting a customer-facing one-pager for caching / batching / streaming best-practices. goal: 1) reduce go-live surprises 2) capture renewal-risk signals 3) give clear enablement steps. any short, high-impact items to include?

Mike (SE): short list:
- do: set small initial batch sizes for interactive workflows (4-8 tokens batch)
- don't: enable aggressive quantization for trial customers w/o evals
- do: enable prefix caching for repeated prompts (cache TTL ~ 10-30m)
- telemetry: surface tail latency + cache hit rate as first-class metrics

Lena (CS): customer-facing framing: keep it prescriptive. 3 panels: "Before Go-live" (prefill + smoke tests), "During Ramp" (warm pools, staggered throttles), "Ongoing" (health signals + renewal triggers). add example copy for support teams.

Tom (Product): add: renewal-risk flags we can detect from infra signals:
- sustained drop in cache-hit % (>40% drop over 24h)
- rising tail latency (95p > SLA by 200ms for >2h)
- spike in partial/failed streams (>3x baseline)
These map to immediate CS outreach + technical triage.

Mike (SE): tiny config snippet customers can copy into their init script:
```
# sample prefill + batching settings (YAML)
prefill: true
prefill_ttl_seconds: 900   # 15m warm window
batching:
  initial_batch_size: 4
  max_batch_size: 16
  jitter_ms: 50
streaming:
  enable_prefix_stream: true
  partial_retry_limit: 2
```

Lena (CS): handoff checklist items for CS <> SE pair:
- pair-run 30-min smoke with customer's top-10 prompts
- confirm metrics dashboard (cache_hit, batch_size, token_rate, tail_latency) visible to both teams
- agree on escalation play: who pages oncall vs who opens a joint-run ticket
- collect 3 sample prompts for eval-run and attach to account notes

Ana (CS): for renewal conversation: prepare a "value snapshot" that ties cost performance improvement to UX: e.g., "we reduced median latency from 420ms -> 210ms and cut per-token cost by 12% via batching + caching". short bullet, 1 slide.

Tom (Product): add observability queries examples (grafana/promql):
```
# % cache hit over 24h
sum(rate(redwood_cache_hits[1h])) / sum(rate(redwood_cache_requests[1h])) * 100
# 95p tail latency
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```

DeployBot: note: new doc created in drive: "CS — Engagement checklist: warm pools, jitter, streaming" by Ana.

Ana (CS): small UX language suggestion for customers: "If you expect bursty traffic, enable prefill and set a short TTL to keep warm workers without sustaining cost." short and action-oriented.

Lena (CS): feedback capture snippet to add to the onboarding form: 
- Did latency meet expectations? (yes/no)
- Did you see unexpected errors in first 48h? (yes/no + free text)
- Which prompts are critical for your app? (free text)
Collect these at day 1, day 3, day 14.

Mike (SE): practical tip: when debugging cold tails, toggle jitter_ms down to 0 for one test run to see raw concurrency effects. also run with tracing enabled for 5-10 minutes only.

Ana (CS): action items:
- i'll stitch these bullets into a 1-page PDF + short 3-slide deck (Ana) — target EOD tomorrow
- Mike: add sample YAML to the repo and a one-click copy link (ETA 24h)
- Lena: i'll pair with you on the 30-min smoke playbook for customers flagged as high renewal risk

Tom (Product): + please add a short line about fallbacks: if model variant fails, route to cheaper / smaller variant and notify CS. keeps the app online during incidents.

Ana (CS): thanks all — this is gold. i'll drop the draft here for quick review. :thumbsup:
